divergences.spec: 繰り返すと定義が言わない tag が 2 つ以上あれば、読む側は最初のものを使う。後続の同じtagも上の検証対象である。

divergences.code: src/oep_client/link.py:check_unit_id, _unit_id; src/oep_client/hardware.py (virtual and real preflight); new core.unit_id_value / core.unit_id
divergences.fix: the first unit_id copy is used only when 1-32 bytes (was: any non-empty value, so a 33+ byte unit_id matched a named one / became the speed-record key)

divergences.fix: describe transport rows count only as 3 bytes (was: any non-empty); confirm's transport only as 1 byte (was: any non-empty, a 2-byte copy used)

divergences.spec: 繰り返すと定義が言わない tag が 2 つ以上あれば、読む側は最初のものを使う。後続の同じtagも上の検証対象である。例えば、正常な既知TLVの後に同じtagで不正な長さの値があれば、要求全体をmalformedで断る。
divergences.fix: a later copy of tag 1 is checked for length and value (malformed / unsupported with that copy's tag), the first used (was: skipped unchecked); the checker's DUPLICATES sends a wrong-length later copy (malformed) and an unhandled later value (unsupported, its tag)

divergences.spec: 知らない TLV（この probe が実装しない tag）: critical なら、probe は要求を rejected unsupported（payload に受け取ったままの tag）で断る。
divergences.fix: an unknown tag is judged on every copy: a critical copy after a non-critical one of the same number is refused unsupported with its tag (was: skipped as a duplicate before the critical check); the checkers send 0x7e then 0xfe (0x41 then 0xc1 for the group's bind) and require unsupported

divergences.spec: 繰り返すと定義が言わない tag が 2 つ以上あれば、読む側は最初のものを使う。後続の同じtagも上の検証対象である。 / core §2.3: 定義が使わずに残した値と、この probe が扱わない値は rejected unsupported（受け取ったままの tag）。
divergences.fix: later copies of configure's mode / rate / samples / segments / trigger / pretrigger are checked for their values: rate / samples / segments 0 malformed, an undeclared mode, a rate outside the declared range, an undefined trigger type or value, a pretrigger past max_pretrigger unsupported with that copy's tag (was: only their length); FIRST-WINS no longer requires a later rate of 1 Hz (below the declared range) to be accepted - it takes a later in-range rate and requires rate 0 malformed and 1 Hz unsupported 0xc2
